title: 第11章 阵破
slug: 苟道剑尊从反夺舍老祖开始长生
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“轰咔——！！”

碎裂的声音在天地间回荡，只见那笼罩了林家前山上百年的淡蓝色光幕，自西北角的一处阵脚陡然裂开。

破阵珠上的血色符文如同毒蛇一般，顺着裂缝啃噬着原本圆融的阵法灵力。

不过两息的功夫，整座二阶护族大阵便在一阵剧烈的摇晃中，寸寸碎裂，化作了漫天的蓝色光点，消散在晚霞之中。

“阵破了！哈哈，林家的儿郎们，随我杀进去！男的鸡犬不留，女的掳回矿山！”

天空中，刘家老祖刘莽狂笑一声，魁梧的身躯轰然砸落。

那柄巨斧上的气血灵力暴涨，一记顺劈，生生将林家山门前两尊数丈高的汉白玉石狮子震成了漫天齑粉，狂暴的劲风顺势将数名躲闪不及的林家炼气期弟子掀翻吐血。

“杀！”

在刘莽和陈万河身后，二十名炼气中后期子弟，化作一道道遁光，冲进了林家山门。

一时间，法术的轰鸣声、符箓的爆炸声以及肉身被利刃撕裂的惨叫声，在前山各处院落中此起彼伏地响了起来。

修仙界家族征伐的残酷，在这一刻展现得淋漓尽致。

林家大长老林崇山看着彻底崩溃的防线，两眼一瞬间变得血红。

他心知今日林家绝无幸免的可能，但他已是退无可退的绝境。

“陈万河！刘莽！纳命来！”

林崇山怒吼一声，一柄通体乌青的飞剑自他口中喷出，化作一道数丈长的青色剑芒，斩向虚空中的陈万河。

“哼，不自量力。”

陈万河悬浮于半空，神色阴鸷，甚至连身形都未曾挪动半分。

他右手并指一点，一柄湛蓝色长剑凭空出现，带起一层层如水波般的剑浪，准确无误地迎上了林崇山的飞剑。

“叮！叮！叮！”

半空中传来密集的法器碰撞之声。

林崇山不过是一名伪筑基，功法粗劣，根基虚浮；

而陈万河却早已是筑基中期，虽说多年未曾打斗，但体内的液化灵力比林崇山雄厚了数倍不止。

不过短短十招，林崇山的面色便由红转白。

随着陈万河湛蓝长剑上的一股巨力涌来，林崇山的本命飞剑悲鸣一声，剑身上的灵光瞬间黯淡，竟是被生生震退了数丈。

林崇山本人更是如遭重击，一口逆血喷涌而出，身形踉跄着向后退去。

“林崇山，若是林玄鹤那老鬼还在，老夫或许还会忌惮三分。至于你……不过是个靠着听我陈家的话，才上位的家奴罢了，也配与老夫过招？”

陈万河冷笑一声，眼中杀机暴涨。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Boom Ka——!!"

The sound of shattering echoed between heaven and earth, and the light blue light curtain that had shrouded the mountain in front of the Lin family for hundreds of years suddenly cracked from a formation in the northwest corner.

The blood-colored runes on the formation-breaking beads were like poisonous snakes, gnawing along the cracks to gnaw at the originally harmonious spiritual power of the formation.

In just two breaths, the entire second-level clan-protecting formation was shaken violently, shattered inch by inch, and turned into blue light spots all over the sky, dissipating in the sunset.

"The formation is broken! Haha, sons and daughters of the Lin family, follow me and fight in! The men will not be spared, and the women will be taken back to the mines!"

In the sky, Liu Mang, the ancestor of the Liu family, laughed wildly, and his burly body crashed down.

The qi, blood and spiritual power on the giant ax surged, and with a slash, the two white marble lions several feet tall in front of the Lin Family Mountain gate were shaken into dust. The violent wind took advantage of the situation and overturned several Lin Family Qi Refining Stage disciples who could not dodge and vomited blood.

"Kill!"

Behind Liu Mang and Chen Wanhe, twenty middle- and late-stage Qi Refining disciples turned into streaks of escaping light and rushed into the Lin Family Mountain Gate.

For a time, the roar of spells, the explosion of talismans, and the screams of flesh being torn apart by sharp blades rang out one after another in various courtyards in the front mountain.

The cruelty of the family's conquest in the world of immortality was vividly displayed at this moment.

Lin Chongshan, the eldest elder of the Lin family, looked at the completely collapsed defense line, and his eyes instantly turned blood red.

He knew in his heart that there was no chance of the Lin family being spared today, but he was already in a desperate situation with no way out.

"Chen Wanhe! Liu Mang! Accept your fate!"

Lin Chongshan roared angrily, and a black-green flying sword spurted out from his mouth, turning into a green sword light several feet long and slashing towards Chen Wanhe in the void.

"Hmph, you don't overestimate your capabilities."

Chen Wanhe was suspended in mid-air with a sinister look on his face, and he did not even move his body.

He pointed his right hands together, and a blue long sword appeared out of thin air, bringing up layers of sword waves like water waves, and met Lin Chongshan's flying sword accurately.

"Ding! Ding! Ding!"

There was a dense sound of collision of magic weapons in mid-air.

Lin Chongshan is just a fake foundation builder, with poor skills and a false foundation;

But Chen Wanhe was already in the middle stage of foundation building. Although he had not fought for many years, the liquefied spiritual power in his body was several times stronger than that of Lin Chongshan.

In just ten moves, Lin Chongshan's complexion turned from red to white.

As a huge force surged from Chen Wanhe's azure long sword, Lin Chongshan's natal flying sword let out a mournful cry. The aura on the sword dimmed instantly, and it was actually shaken back several feet.

Lin Chongshan himself felt as if he had been hit hard, a mouthful of blood spurted out, and he staggered back.

"Lin Chongshan, if that old ghost Lin Xuanhe is still there, I might still be wary of you. As for you... you are just a house slave who rose to power by listening to my Chen family's words. Are you worthy of competing with me?"

Chen Wanhe sneered, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
